page.welcomeBody: Drop a document (quote, invoice, deck…): the link to send is ready in a second.
page.emptyDescription: As soon as a prospect opens their link, they show up here with what to do next.
page.draftsHintAutopilot: tricky cases wait for your approval
page.feedEmpty: Reads, your prospects' replies and sent follow-ups will show up here.
page.mailClientLink: Clozer can create the link right inside your emails
page.dealsInProgress: {count, plural, one {# active prospect} other {# active prospects}}

headline.drafts: {count, plural, one {A follow-up is waiting for your OK.} other {# follow-ups are waiting for your OK.}}
headline.validatedMany: {name} and {others, plural, one {# other} other {# others}} approved.
headline.validatedHint: Plan the next step while it's hot.
headline.noDocumentHint: Add a PDF or a link to get started.
headline.readyOneHint: “{name}” is waiting to be sent: paste the link into your email instead of the attachment.
headline.readyManyHint: Paste each one into your email instead of the attachment: you'll know who reads what.
headline.createLinkHint: Create a link to send it to a prospect.
headline.autoFollowups: Clozer prepares follow-ups when they're needed.
headline.warmOne: A prospect is looking at your document.
headline.warmMany: {count} prospects are looking at your documents.
headline.unopenedOne: Your link hasn't been opened yet.
headline.unopenedAll: No link has been opened yet.

todo.unopenedCount: {count, plural, one {# link not opened yet} other {# links not opened yet}}
todo.unopenedHint: · you'll hear as soon as one is read

readyLinks.copiedToast: Link copied. Paste it into your message: you'll hear as soon as it's opened.
readyLinks.copyError: Couldn't copy: open the link to copy it by hand.
readyLinks.undoFailed: Couldn't bring it back. Create a new link from the document.

hints.opened: At least one read, bots aside.
hints.deep: Half the PDF with at least 30 s of reading, a minute on a web link, or a long read of the pricing.
hints.validated: “Approve & sign” clicked, or prospect marked approved or won.

autopilot.none: No follow-up went out on its own in the last 24 h.
autopilot.sent: {count, plural, one {# follow-up went out on its own in the last 24 h.} other {# follow-ups went out on their own in the last 24 h.}}

nextAction.aiWait: Nothing to do for now, Clozer is watching.
nextAction.closeWon: Approved by the prospect: confirm the sale.
nextAction.reactivateAsked: Document asked for again {when}: reactivate the link.
nextAction.reactivateReturned: Back on the link {when}: reactivate it.
nextAction.reviewDraft: Follow-up ready: review and approve it.
nextAction.meetingBooked: Meeting booked {when}: get ready for it.
nextAction.meetingAhead: Meeting on {date}: get ready for it.
nextAction.meetingPast: Meeting done: note how it went.
nextAction.inTouch: Contact logged {when}, give them some time.
nextAction.callPricing: Long read of the pricing: call.
nextAction.nudgeOpened: No reads for {days} days: follow up.
nextAction.nudgeUnopened: Not opened for {days} days, auto follow-ups off: follow up.
nextAction.waitWarm: Steady reading, nothing to do for now.
nextAction.replyEmail: They replied by email: your move.
nextAction.clickedNotRead: Clicked the link, but stopped at the email screen.
nextAction.nudgeClicked: Clicked {days} days ago and went no further: send the link again.
nextAction.identifyLive: Someone unknown is reading now: match the time with your sends to find out who.
nextAction.identify: Someone unknown read a lot: find out who before calling anyone.

feed.readForPricing: read for {duration}, {pricing} of it on pricing

action.REQUEST_RELINK: is asking for the document again

alert.prospectQuestion: has a question waiting for your answer
alert.multiViewerCount: is being read by {count} people at once
alert.multiViewer: is being read by several people
alert.draftReady: has a follow-up ready to approve
alert.extensionRequested: expired: the prospect is asking for an extension
alert.relinkRequested: was archived: the prospect is asking for it again
alert.deadLinkOpenedArchived: was archived: the prospect came back to it
alert.deadLinkOpenedExpired: has expired: the prospect came back to it
alert.committeeLive: is being read by {count} people at once (committee)
alert.committeeLiveSeveral: is being read by several people at once (committee)
alert.decisionMaker: is being read by a decision-maker
alert.reopened: was reopened after a quiet spell
alert.prospectReplied: got an email reply from the prospect
alert.emailBounced: has an email address that bounced

feed.followupAntiGhosting: got a follow-up by {channel} (link not opened yet)

frictions.stops: {count} of {total} prospects stop at page {page}: the rest goes unread.
frictions.stopsAbout: {count} of {total} prospects stop at page {page} ({about}): the rest goes unread.
frictions.allFinished: All {count} prospects who opened it read to the end.
frictions.aiFriction: The analysis sees {friction} as a blocker for {count} prospects.
